description:
At i360technologies, we deliver business consulting and technology solutions that support the mission of federal agencies. i360 is seeking a Oracle Application Developer to sustain the software that supports the client's Oracle Federal Financials environment, operated as a shared service serving multiple agencies and roughly 19,000 user accounts. This role modifies, maintains, and troubleshoots existing software and automations, keeps the supporting applications healthy, and provides senior technical support to users. This is a designated key personnel position.

 Key Responsibilities 

 
 Maintain, modify, and troubleshoot existing software, interfaces, and automations that support the Oracle Federal Financials environment.

 Diagnose and resolve software defects and performance issues, and enhance software to improve reliability and performance.

 Provide senior technical support to users and to the help desk on escalated software issues.

 Support release activities, including configuration changes, upgrades, and patches, and validate that software changes work as intended.

 Develop and test scripts and code changes in line with the client's policies and configuration management standards.

 Document software changes, maintain operating procedures, and contribute to technical documentation.

 Coordinate with the architect, functional, help desk, and program leads to align software maintenance with the release schedule and operational needs.

 
 Qualifications 

 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

 Minimum 8 years of related experience.

 Demonstrated experience maintaining, modifying, and troubleshooting enterprise software and providing technical user support.

 Hands-on development and scripting skills (for example, SQL/PL/SQL and related technologies).

 Ability to pass a federal background investigation and obtain client site access.

 
 Security & Eligibility Requirements 

 
 Ability to obtain and maintain a federal Public Trust (suitability) clearance

 Must be able to pass a federal background investigation

 U.S. Citizenship or Permanent Residency required (no visa sponsorship available)

 
 Nice to Have

 
 Software maintenance experience with Oracle E-Business Suite or Oracle Federal Financials, including interfaces and automations.

 Familiarity with federal financial management environments and shared service operations.

 Experience with Oracle EBS 12.2 upgrades, quarterly security patches, configuration management, and ServiceNow-managed change control.

 
 Benefits 

 
 Referral Bonus

 (401k) Matching

 Holidays – Eleven

 Technology Reimbursement

 Short-Term & Long-Term Disability

 Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)

 Paid Time Off (0-3 years - 15 Days PTO | 3+ years 20 Days)

 80% Employer Paid Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)

 
 Equal Opportunity Employer Minority/Female/Veteran/Disability

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or status within any other protected group.

 Only direct applicants will be considered. Submissions from recruiting or staffing firms will not be accepted.
